cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I folded my ticket like yours. Tea line confirmed. Drop the private-queue request; everyone at the fete uses this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was folding my donation receipt. I donated the tent; can't that count for something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Receipts filed. Your name's on the thank-you board beside the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody can read it behind that urn.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll move the urn. You can accept everyone's thanks while you wait your turn.
